opening.argument: The video presents a purported free Starbucks gift card displayed at a value of $100, making the reward appear readily obtainable. The description instructs viewers to “Simply Click The Link” and “Enter Your Email” before they can “Enjoy Your Free Starbucks Gift Card.” That low-barrier acquisition requires an external click and submission of personal contact information, while the destination, offeror, collection process, authorization, and delivery remain unverified. The offer therefore rests on an unverified promise of a valuable reward in exchange for directed data submission.
